query: Please implement an AI tool product website for generating text, images, and videos. The website should have functionalities for generating text, images, and videos. Users should be able to log in, input relevant parameters, and generate the required text, images, or videos. The website should also have features for previewing and downloading the generated content. Use alabaster for the background and dark cyan for components.
